mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN k.owner_id = #{userId} THEN 'admin' ELSE u.role END AS role FROM rag_kb k LEFT JOIN rag_kb_user u ON u.kb_id = k.id AND u.user_id = #{userId} WHERE k.id = #{kbId} AND (k.owner_id = #{userId} OR u.user_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_kb WHERE id = #{kbId}

SELECT k.id, k.name, k.owner_id AS ownerId, k.create_time AS createTime FROM rag_kb k LEFT JOIN rag_kb_user u ON u.kb_id = k.id AND u.user_id = #{userId} WHERE k.owner_id = #{userId} OR u.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY k.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_kb_user (kb_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{userId}, #{role}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role = VALUES(role)
